title: Pinned single comparison along a scheme isomorphism
statement:
theorem picardTermwiseSingleMap_isIso_of_iso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : X ≅ Y) (M : Y.Modules) :
    letI := fun Z : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))
    IsIso (Scheme.picardTermwiseSingleMap s.hom M)

proof.text: Tensor pullback along the inverse scheme isomorphism is an inverse equivalence, using tensor pullback composition and identity isomorphisms. Consequently tensor pullback is exact. Its exact derived functor, equipped with its invertible comparison, is a left derived functor. Uniqueness of left derived functors gives an isomorphism whose inverse component followed by the pinned counit equals this invertible comparison. Cancellation proves the pinned counit component invertible. Expand the definition of the pinned single map: its other factors are single-complex comparison and adjoint-uniqueness isomorphisms. Their composite is invertible.
